enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Put down toothbrush. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Close cabinet. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour into pan. Cook. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink milk. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Pick up clipboard. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to nurses station. Discuss with colleague. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Review patient files. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot and pan. Close cabinet. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Chop vegetables. Add oil to pan. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Close laptop. Put down laptop. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Put down toothbrush. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
